table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Accounts.Name,
	Accounts.AliasName,
	Glheader.vochcatcode,   
	GLDetail.Debit,   
	GLDetail.Credit,   
	GLDetail.ChkNo,   
	remarks=GLDetail.Remarks,   
	Glheader.Posted,
	Glheader.Date,   
	Glheader.Remarks,   
	VocherCategory.Name,   
	Users.UserName,   
	Glheader.GLVochCode,
	Glheader.VoucherCode,
	CreditorDebit = Case GLDetail.Debit When 0 Then 'C' Else 'D' End,
	gldetail.glrowid,
	InvoiceCode=GLDetail.InvoiceCode,
	Outstandingamt = GLDetail.Outstandingamt,
	InvoiceBased=VocherCategory.InvoiceBased,
	StudentCode=GLDetail.StudentCode,
	StudentRegNo = (SELECT S.Regno FROM Student S WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode),
	StudentName = (SELECT S.Name FROM Student S WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode),
	StudentFName = (SELECT S.FName FROM Student S WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode),
	Grade = (SELECT G.Name 
		FROM Student S, Class C, StudentClass SC, Grade G
		WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode AND 
			S.CurrentClass=C.ClassCode AND
			C.GradeCode = G.GradeCode AND
			C.ClassCode = SC.ClassCode AND
			S.Studentcode = SC.Studentcode),
	Class = (SELECT C.Name 
		FROM Student S, Class C, StudentClass SC, Grade G
		WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode AND 
			S.CurrentClass=C.ClassCode AND
			C.GradeCode = G.GradeCode AND
			C.ClassCode = SC.ClassCode AND
			S.Studentcode = SC.Studentcode),
	Section = (SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(C.Name, CHARINDEX(',', C.Name, 1)+1, CHARINDEX(',', SUBSTRING(C.Name, CHARINDEX(',', C.Name, 1)-1, LEN(C.Name)),1))))
		FROM Student S, Class C, StudentClass SC
		WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode AND 
			S.CurrentClass=C.ClassCode AND
			C.ClassCode = SC.ClassCode AND
			S.Studentcode = SC.Studentcode),
	ClassMedium = (SELECT CM.Name 
		FROM Student S, Class C, StudentClass SC, ClassMedium CM
		WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode AND 
			S.CurrentClass=C.ClassCode AND
			C.ClassMediumCode = CM.ClassMediumCode AND
			C.ClassCode = SC.ClassCode AND
			S.Studentcode = SC.Studentcode),
	RollNo = (SELECT SC.RollNo 
		FROM Student S, StudentClass SC
		WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode AND 
			S.CurrentClass=SC.ClassCode AND
			S.Studentcode = SC.Studentcode),
	School = (SELECT School.Name 
		FROM Student S, Class C, StudentClass SC, School 
		WHERE S.Studentcode = GLDetail.StudentCode AND 
			S.CurrentClass=C.ClassCode AND
			C.SchoolCode = School.SchoolCode AND
			C.ClassCode = SC.ClassCode AND
			S.Studentcode = SC.Studentcode)
FROM 
	GLDetail,   
	Glheader,   
	Accounts,   
	VocherCategory,   
	Users  
WHERE 
	( Glheader.GLVochCode = GLDetail.GLVochCode ) and  
	( Accounts.AccCode = GLDetail.AccCode ) and  
	( VocherCategory.VochCatCode = Glheader.VochCatCode ) and  
	( Users.UserCode = Glheader.salesmancode ) and  
	( Glheader.GLVochCode = :ar_code ) AND
	( Glheader.AccCode <> GLDetail.AccCode ) AND
	( GLDetail.Credit > 0 )
table.sort: glheader_glvochcode A, studentregno A, studentname A, aliasname A, accounts_name A

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: sum(if( gldetail_debit > 0, gldetail_debit, gldetail_credit) for group 1)
